verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation, scheduled job, or background workflow feature in Mastercard Open Finance. The related items are adjacent only: daily transaction-data refresh is a built-in platform process rather than a user-defined automation, and webhooks/OBWMS push event notifications, which a developer would still have to build automations on top of.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
